title: Smashed Avocado Chicken Burgers with Soy-Lime Mayo
changes_from_base: A little mashed avocado keeps the chicken mince tender, and the patties are packed with coriander, ginger, garlic and spring onion, smashed thin in a hot pan for a crust and finished with soy-lime mayonnaise and avocado slices.
summary: Chicken thigh burgers folded with buttery mashed avocado, aromatic ginger and fresh coriander stay juicy inside with a crispy golden exterior, served with cooling lime-soy mayo.
equipment: large cast-iron or heavy frying pan (30 cm) with a lid

ingredients.item: coriander leaves and tender stalks, roughly chopped, plus extra to serve
ripe Hass avocado (60 g mashed for the patties, the rest sliced to serve)
spring onions, white and pale green parts, thinly sliced
fine sea salt or table salt
brioche or burger buns, lightly toasted

steps.title: Soy-lime mayo
steps.text: Stir together 75 g mayonnaise and 1 tsp soy sauce in a small serving bowl, then squeeze juice from 1 lime wedge into it and season to taste.

steps.title: Avocado mixture
steps.text: In a medium mixing bowl, use a fork to mash and combine 30 g coriander leaves and tender stalks, 60 g mashed ripe Hass avocado, 2 sliced spring onions, 3 finely grated garlic cloves, 10 g finely grated fresh ginger, ¼ tsp dried chilli flakes, 1 tsp fine salt and 1 tbsp of the soy-lime mayo until just mixed through.

steps.title: Chicken patties
steps.text: Add 450 g chicken mince (preferably thigh) to the avocado mixture and fold together gently until just combined. Roll the mixture into 4 large balls.

steps.title: Heat pan
steps.text: Set a large cast-iron or heavy frying pan over a medium heat and warm it for 1.5-2 minutes until very hot. Add 30 ml neutral oil, then space the chicken balls evenly apart in the pan.

steps.title: Shape and sear
steps.text: Using a metal fish slice, press each ball down into a patty about 1 cm thick. Leave them untouched for 3.5-4 minutes until a deep golden crust forms on the bottom and the patties release easily from the pan.

steps.title: Cook through
steps.text: Turn the patties and cook the other side for about 3 minutes, then cover the pan for 1-2 minutes more if needed until the thickest part reaches 74 °C when checked with a thermometer. Squeeze a lime wedge over the patties.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Place each patty in a lightly toasted brioche or burger bun and top with a soft lettuce leaf, a generous dollop of soy-lime mayo, sliced avocado, thin slices of jalapeño if you like, and fresh coriander leaves. Serve with extra lime wedges and mayo on the side.

tips: Use chicken thigh mince if possible; it's more forgiving than breast mince and stays moister and more flavourful through cooking.
Press the chicken balls into patties just before cooking, not ahead of time, so they hold together better and develop that essential golden crust.
Set aside some sliced avocado to pile on top of the burger just before serving for a cool, buttery contrast to the hot chicken.
storage: Best assembled and eaten straight away while the burgers are still warm and the toppings are fresh. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
